{{Top|leg}}
A '''power stabilizer''' was a component used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]]<ref name="IF">{{WEGCite|story=The Iskallon Factor|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref> and [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="PF">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Plant Food|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref> Sublight drives would not engage if one of the power stabilizers was missing or damaged.<ref name="IF" />
